automation_notes: Automated strategies can be used in the Trading Combine and Funded Accounts. TopstepX API available ($29/mo via ProjectX Dashboard; Topstep traders reportedly receive 50% off with code 'topstep' = $14.50/mo, no stated expiration — verify at help.topstep.com/en/articles/11187768). No VPS/VPN usage allowed - must trade from personal device. No HFT. Topstep provides zero support for automation troubleshooting.

150000.price_change_note: Increased from $149 to $199/mo for new subscriptions effective June 2, 2026

no_activation_fee_path.description: Alternative pricing path with higher monthly fee but $0 activation fee when you pass. Pricing updated April 28, 2026. Best for traders confident they will pass in 1-2 attempts.

50000.daily_loss_limit_notes: No mandatory daily loss limit during the Trading Combine. A personal daily loss limit feature is available optionally via TopstepX settings; breaching it suspends trading for the remainder of the session but does NOT fail or reset the account.
50000.drawdown_notes: EOD trailing during evaluation — trailing high-water mark is only updated at end of each trading day, not intraday. Switches to intraday trailing drawdown after funding.
50000.contract_limit_progression: May increase in Express Funded Account after profit milestones; verify current limits at help.topstep.com
50000.consistency_rule_description: No single day can exceed 50% of the profit target (e.g., max $1,500/day for a $50K account with a $3,000 target)
50000.allows_overnight_notes: All positions must be closed by 3:10 PM CT every weekday. Topstep does not permit holding positions from one session to the next. Positions remaining open at 3:10 PM CT are auto-liquidated. Trading resumes at 5:00 PM CT. Topstep is a day-trading program only.
50000.allows_news_trading_notes: News trading is allowed with no hard blackout windows or restricted time periods. Topstep does not publish a formal news-trading restriction. However, purposefully trading at maximum position size into a major news event is a prohibited strategy and can result in account review or closure.
50000.trading_platforms_notes: Since July 7, 2025, all new Trading Combines run exclusively on TopstepX. Legacy accounts on NinjaTrader or Tradovate are grandfathered and may continue trading, but resets became TopstepX-only from August 1, 2025. TradingView charts are integrated within TopstepX (not a separate execution platform).

payout_structure.first_payout_bonus_description: The 100% first-$10K bonus was discontinued for accounts opened after January 12, 2026. Traders who joined before that date retain it (grandfathered). All new traders receive the standard 90/10 split from day one.

payout_processing_fee.notes: $30 fee deducted from each ACH or Wire payout (applied after the 90/10 profit split). No Topstep fee for Wise or Aeropay; bank or service fees may apply separately.

standard.payout_eligibility: 5 winning trading days per payout cycle (winning day = net PnL ≥ $150)
standard.notes: Maximum payout is the lower of the per-account-size cap or 50% of your reward balance per cycle. April 28, 2026 reduction affected new 50K and 100K accounts only. Caps by account size: 50K=$2,000 (down from $5,000), 100K=$3,000 (down from $5,000), 150K=$5,000 (unchanged). The max_payout_per_cycle value reflects the 50K cap as the minimum floor. Accounts that activated their EFA before April 28, 2026 retain the original $5,000 cap regardless of account size.

consistency.payout_eligibility: 3 trading days per payout cycle; largest single winning day must be ≤ 40% of total net profit for the payout window
consistency.notes: Maximum payout is the lower of the per-account-size cap or 50% of your reward balance. April 28, 2026 reduction affected new 50K and 100K accounts only. Caps by account size: 50K=$3,000 (down from $6,000), 100K=$3,000 (down from $6,000), 150K=$6,000 (unchanged). The max_payout_per_cycle value reflects the 50K cap as the minimum floor. Accounts that activated their EFA before April 28, 2026 retain the original $6,000 cap regardless of account size. Allows faster payout cycles in exchange for a 40% consistency constraint.

repeat_payout_minimum_balance.description: Two-condition rule for all Express Funded Account payouts after the first: (1) must meet the chosen path's winning-days/consistency requirement AND (2) must have a net-positive balance relative to the post-payout starting balance (Minimum Payout Balance). If the account balance dropped below the post-payout starting balance at any time, no withdrawal can be requested until the balance recovers above it. The first payout still requires only the path's winning-days requirement.
repeat_payout_minimum_balance.applies_to: all EFA payouts after the first

dll_double_payout_cap_promotion.description: Traders who add a Daily Loss Limit (DLL) to their account at checkout when purchasing a Trading Combine unlock double the standard per-request EFA payout caps. The DLL must be added at the Trading Combine purchase stage — adding it during EFA activation or reactivation does NOT qualify. No end date established; Topstep may modify or terminate at any time. Topstep X announcement: 'Add a DLL and unlock DOUBLE payout caps up to $12,000.'
dll_double_payout_cap_promotion.condition: DLL added at Trading Combine checkout only; not at EFA activation/reactivation stage
dll_double_payout_cap_promotion.additional_benefits: $50 off eligible Back2Funded EFA reactivations for DLL holders (see back2funded section for full Back2Funded rules including 30-day reactivation window); discounted Trading Combine pricing during limited-time offering

payout_structure.payout_frequency: On request, once payout eligibility requirements are met per chosen EFA path
payout_structure.payout_frequency_notes: Two EFA paths since February 5, 2026: Standard (5 winning days of $150+) and Consistency (3 trading days with ≤40% best-day share). As of December 30, 2025, all payouts after the first require BOTH the path's winning-days requirement AND a Minimum Payout Balance (net profitable since the last payout). Payout caps by account size for new accounts (April 28, 2026 reduction): Standard path: 50K=$2K, 100K=$3K, 150K=$5K (unchanged); Consistency path: 50K=$3K, 100K=$3K, 150K=$6K (unchanged). Accounts activated before April 28, 2026 are grandfathered at original caps ($5K Standard / $6K Consistency regardless of size). DLL DOUBLE CAP PROMOTION (June 2, 2026, no end date): Traders who add a Daily Loss Limit at Trading Combine checkout unlock double caps — Standard: 50K=$4K, 100K=$6K, 150K=$10K; Consistency: 50K=$6K, 100K=$6K, 150K=$12K. DLL must be added at Combine purchase, not EFA activation stage. ACH and Wire payouts carry a $30 processing fee deducted after the 90/10 split; Wise and Aeropay carry no Topstep fee. Live Funded Account has separate rules: payouts capped at 50% of profits until 30 qualifying winning days are accumulated, after which daily payouts and 100% access unlock.

scaling_requirements.details: Can request account scaling after demonstrating consistent profitability. Note: Live Funded Accounts use Dynamic Live Risk Expansion (since July 22, 2025) instead of a fixed Scaling Plan — risk limits and contract sizes adjust automatically based on real-time performance.

back2funded.description: Back2Funded allows traders who lose their Express Funded Account (XFA) before their first payout to reactivate it at a discounted cost, without repeating the Trading Combine.
back2funded.reactivation_window_notes: On May 29, 2026, Topstep extended the reactivation window from 7 days to 30 days. Accounts that had the original 7-day window expire were retroactively updated to show their remaining time based on the 30-day period.
back2funded.eligibility: XFA must have been earned through the Trading Combine, closed due to a rule violation BEFORE any payout was taken, be on TopstepX in the new Topstep Dashboard, and the trader must be in good standing. Once a payout is taken from an XFA, it is no longer eligible for Back2Funded.
back2funded.account_limit_impact: Back2Funded-eligible XFAs do not count toward the 5-account limit until the reactivation fee is paid.
back2funded.dll_discount: $50 off eligible Back2Funded reactivations for traders who added a Daily Loss Limit at Trading Combine checkout (see dll_double_payout_cap_promotion).
back2funded.account_continuity: Reactivation preserves the same account size and payout policy as the original XFA.

topstep_octagon.description: Monthly performance bonus competition for Live Funded Account (LFA) traders. The top 100 LFA traders ranked by monthly Net PnL share a $250,000 prize pool each month. Automatically enrolled — no sign-up required.
topstep_octagon.eligibility: All Live Funded Accounts are automatically enrolled. Opt-out is available by contacting Topstep Support; opting out removes the account from the leaderboard and forfeits bonus eligibility.
topstep_octagon.ranking_method: Total monthly Net PnL. Each LFA starts at a virtual $0 for ranking purposes at the beginning of each calendar month, regardless of actual account balance entering the month.
topstep_octagon.payout_timing: Bonuses paid the following month after leaderboard rankings are finalized; added directly to the LFA account balance.
topstep_octagon.applies_to: Live Funded Accounts only — not Express Funded Accounts or Trading Combines

topstep_labs.description: Topstep Labs is an experimental program releasing limited-time, limited-availability Trading Combine variants with non-standard rules. Once a Labs drop sells out, it is not restocked. Visit topstep.com/labs for current availability. Drop #001: $25K Static Combine (announced July 7, 2026; $499 one-time fee; static MLL). Drop #002: $250K Freedom Trading Combine (announced approximately mid-July 2026; one-time fee, amount unconfirmed; EOD-trailing $10K MLL; treated as $150K in LFA).

drop_001.name: $25K Static Trading Combine
drop_001.status: Limited availability — may be sold out. Verify at topstep.com/labs.
drop_001.drawdown_notes: Max Loss Limit is FIXED at $24,000 (i.e., $1,000 below the $25K starting balance) and NEVER trails. Contrast with standard accounts where the MLL trails the EOD closing balance.
drop_001.profit_target_notes: Profit target confirmed as $2,000 from multiple third-party sources. Verify at topstep.com/labs if precision required.
drop_001.path: Same Express Funded Account and Live Funded Account path as standard Trading Combines.

drop_002.name: $250K Freedom Trading Combine
drop_002.status: Limited availability — may be sold out. Verify at topstep.com/labs.
drop_002.drawdown_notes: Max Loss Limit trails EOD closing balance, structured like Standard Trading Combines. Daily Loss Limit (DLL) is mandatory (included by default). MLL of $10,000 = 4% of $250K starting balance, consistent with standard combine percentages for 100K/150K accounts.
drop_002.profit_target_notes: Profit target $15,000 confirmed from multiple sources (6% of $250K account size, same percentage as standard combines).
drop_002.payout_cap_notes: Specific EFA payout cap not confirmed from official sources; once moved to LFA the account is treated as a $150K — verify payout caps at topstep.com/labs.
drop_002.fee_notes: One-time fee confirmed (no subscription, rebill, or reset). Specific dollar amount not confirmed from official sources; verify at topstep.com/labs.
drop_002.lfa_treatment: Once moved to a Live Funded Account, the account follows standard Live Funded Account parameters and is treated as a $150K account.
drop_002.path: Same Express Funded Account and Live Funded Account path as standard Trading Combines. LFA treated as $150K account parameters.

key_differentiator: Most established prop firm (2012), best education and coaching, TopstepX API for automation
pros: Two EFA payout paths: Standard (5 days) or Consistency (3 days, 40% constraint); payout caps for new accounts: 50K=$2K Standard/$3K Consistency; 100K=$3K Standard/$3K Consistency; 150K=$5K Standard/$6K Consistency (unchanged); DLL holders (opt-in at Combine checkout) unlock double caps: Standard 50K=$4K/100K=$6K/150K=$10K; Consistency 50K=$6K/100K=$6K/150K=$12K (since June 2, 2026)
No Activation Fee path available ($0 on pass, introduced November 2025)
Topstep Octagon: monthly $250K bonus competition for Live Funded Account traders (launched July 1, 2026); top 100 by monthly Net PnL automatically enrolled

Topstep Labs: experimental limited-availability combines — Drop #001: $25K Static ($499 one-time, non-trailing $1K MLL, $2K profit target, $4K EFA payout cap); Drop #002: $250K Freedom (~mid-July 2026, one-time fee, $10K EOD-trailing MLL, $15K profit target, treated as $150K in LFA); visit topstep.com/labs
Back2Funded: up to 2 EFA reactivations without re-challenging Combine; 30-day window (extended from 7 days on May 29, 2026)
cons: Standard path activation fee $149 (avoidable via No Activation Fee path at higher monthly cost); 150K standard monthly fee increased from $149 to $199 for new subscriptions effective June 2, 2026
Switches to intraday trailing drawdown after funding
No overnight or weekend holding — day-trading only, all positions auto-liquidated at 3:10 PM CT
VPS/VPN not allowed (must trade from personal device)
New accounts restricted to TopstepX platform only since July 7, 2025; legacy NinjaTrader/Tradovate accounts grandfathered but resets are TopstepX-only since August 1, 2025
First-$10K 100% payout bonus discontinued for accounts opened after January 12, 2026

EFA payout caps cut for new 50K and 100K accounts on April 28 2026: 50K Standard $2K/cycle (was $5K), 50K Consistency $3K/cycle (was $6K); 100K Standard $3K/cycle (was $5K), 100K Consistency $3K/cycle (was $6K); 150K accounts unaffected (kept $5K/$6K); ACH/Wire withdrawals carry a $30 processing fee

Repeat EFA payouts (after the first) require a two-condition test: meet winning-days requirement AND maintain net-positive balance since last payout (Minimum Payout Balance, effective December 30, 2025)
notes: Topstep is the gold standard for education-focused prop trading. Automation is explicitly allowed and they provide an API (TopstepX). VPS/VPN strictly prohibited — all trading must originate from a personal device. Topstep is a day-trading program: all positions must be closed by 3:10 PM CT every weekday; positions are auto-liquidated at that time. Trading resumes at 5:00 PM CT. No overnight or weekend holding. News trading is allowed — Topstep publishes no hard news-event blackout, but purposefully trading at maximum position size into a major news event is a prohibited strategy. PLATFORM POLICY: Since July 7, 2025, all new Trading Combines run exclusively on TopstepX. Legacy NinjaTrader and Tradovate accounts are grandfathered and may continue trading their existing accounts, but resets became TopstepX-only effective August 1, 2025. TradingView charting is integrated within TopstepX; it is not a separate order execution platform. As of February 28, 2026, ProjectX technology became exclusive to Topstep (other prop firms were removed from the platform). The 100% first-$10K payout bonus was grandfathered out for new accounts after January 12, 2026. Two pricing paths exist: Standard ($49/$99/$199/mo + $149 activation — note 150K was $149/mo before June 2, 2026) and No Activation Fee ($95/$149/$229/mo, $0 activation, pricing updated April 28, 2026). Since February 5, 2026, the Express Funded Account comes in two variants: Standard (requires 5 winning days of $150+) and Consistency (requires 3 trading days with ≤40% best-day concentration). As of December 30, 2025, all EFA payouts after the first require a two-condition test: meet the path's winning-days requirement AND maintain net-positive balance since the last payout (Minimum Payout Balance). As of April 28, 2026, EFA payout caps were cut for new 50K and 100K accounts: 50K Standard=$2K/cycle, 50K Consistency=$3K/cycle; 100K Standard=$3K/cycle, 100K Consistency=$3K/cycle; 150K accounts retain the original $5K/$6K caps unchanged. Accounts that activated before April 28, 2026 retain the original caps. ACH and Wire payouts carry a $30 processing fee (deducted after the 90/10 split); Wise and Aeropay carry no Topstep fee. As of June 2, 2026, traders who voluntarily add a Daily Loss Limit (DLL) at Trading Combine checkout unlock double EFA payout caps (up to $12,000 on the Consistency 150K path): Standard path doubles to 50K=$4K, 100K=$6K, 150K=$10K; Consistency path doubles to 50K=$6K, 100K=$6K, 150K=$12K. DLL must be added at Combine purchase stage, not at EFA activation. DLL holders also receive $50 off Back2Funded EFA reactivations. Offer has no stated end date but Topstep may modify or terminate at any time. A Live Funded Account tier exists beyond EFA for consistently profitable traders. As of July 22, 2025, Live Funded Accounts use Dynamic Live Risk Expansion (replacing the old Scaling Plan) — risk limits and contract sizes scale automatically with real-time performance. As of July 1, 2026, Live Funded Account traders are automatically enrolled in the Topstep Octagon, a monthly competition awarding $250,000 in bonuses split among the top 100 traders by Net PnL (see topstep_octagon section). Topstep Labs (topstep.com/labs) offers experimental limited-availability Trading Combine variants with non-standard rules. Drop #001 (announced July 7, 2026) is the $25K Static Combine featuring a non-trailing $1,000 Max Loss Limit, $2,000 profit target, $4,000 EFA payout cap, $499 one-time fee, and 90-day expiry. Drop #002 (announced approximately mid-July 2026) is the $250K Freedom Trading Combine featuring $15,000 profit target, $10,000 EOD-trailing Max Loss Limit, mandatory DLL, one-time fee (dollar amount unconfirmed — verify at topstep.com/labs), 90-day expiry, and LFA treatment as a $150K account. See topstep_labs section for full details. Back2Funded allows up to 2 EFA reactivations without repeating the Combine; the reactivation window was extended from 7 to 30 days on May 29, 2026 (see back2funded section).
